[Section] Experiments ::: Part-of-Speech Tagging ::: Baselines
[source_id=47] We use the following baselines:
[source_id=48] Joint-POS: shao2017character jointly learns Chinese word segmentation and POS.
[source_id=49] Lattice-LSTM: lattice2018zhang constructs a word-character lattice.
[source_id=50] Bert-Tagger: devlin2018bert treats part-of-speech as a tagging task.
